name: Chronic Inflammation Is the Root of All Disease
claim: Low-grade chronic inflammation, driven by modern diet and lifestyle, is the hidden cause of fatigue, pain and most chronic illness — and can be reversed by eating specific anti-inflammatory foods.
born_note: Estimate based on mid-2000s popularization of 'inflammation as root of disease' in mainstream health media and diet books. (model estimate, pending audit)

explanations.layman: This is the popular idea that a quiet, ongoing 'fire' inside your body causes tiredness, aches and long-term illness — and that eating the right foods puts the fire out. It's why you keep seeing lists of berries, olive oil and oily fish. Some of it is backed by science; a lot of it is oversimplified and used to sell books, supplements and courses.
explanations.intermediate: Inflammation is a real biological process linked to cardiovascular and metabolic disease. The narrative extends that link into a single unifying cause of chronic illness, then offers dietary patterns as the lever. Camps: clinicians promoting whole-food Mediterranean-style eating with reasonable evidence; wellness marketers selling supplements and elimination diets; and skeptics noting markers like CRP are nonspecific and food-level claims rarely survive trials.
explanations.expert: Lifecycle: mature, highly commercialized, continually refreshed by microbiome and polyphenol research. Falsifiers: RCTs showing no clinical outcome benefit from specific 'anti-inflammatory' foods independent of overall diet quality; inconsistent CRP/IL-6 effects. Clocks: publication cycles for books/programs, seasonal 'reset' content. Incentives: content is evergreen, SEO-rich, and funnels to recipe books, coaching and supplement affiliates. Audit by checking whether claims cite outcome trials or only biomarker studies.
